authorizedRoute.routeType: public first-party Music Director email with an authorized physical-mail alternative
authorizedRoute.contactPublication: WREK's official submission guidance publishes the Music Director mailbox twice and is linked directly from the current WREK Music page.
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: The official guidance states that music may be submitted by email or snail mail and confirms that independently produced music is accepted.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Send one concise asset-free inquiry to the published Music Director mailbox to confirm the current digital delivery method before supplying files or private links. A physical package may be considered only after confirming the current postal address.
authorizedRoute.audioDeliveryAuthorized: Email and physical music delivery are explicitly authorized, but the current digital attachment-versus-link method, formats and file-size limits are not published.
authorizedRoute.physicalRoute: The linked submission guidance lists WREK 91.1 FM, 350 Ferst Drive, Georgia Tech, John Lewis Student Center, Suite 2140, Atlanta, GA 30332. Other official WREK pages display different street numbers or suite numbers, so the address must be confirmed before mailing.

emails.verification: Published twice in plaintext on WREK's official submission guidance, explicitly for music submissions and Music Director contact. The address has valid syntax and exactly matches WREK's official wrek.org domain.

businessContact.emailStatus: source-verified public Music Director business mailbox
businessContact.verification: The current WREK Music page links directly to the official submission guidance where the mailbox is published. No address was guessed or copied from a third-party directory. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: No form is required. Human review is still required because the currently linked guidance is hosted on WREK's legacy official subdomain, digital payload specifications are absent and official postal-address representations conflict.
adjacentRoutesExcluded: duplicate simultaneous email and postal delivery

activityVerification.evidence: WREK's current official homepage states that it broadcasts 24/7, exposes a live player and 14-day archive, and displayed current official playlists or posts dated July 10 and July 15, 2026. The current Music page links directly to the official submission guidance.

genreFitEvidence: WREK's current Music page lists an Electronic sound block and an Overnight Alternatives block for experimental, industrial and noise.
Its Rock, Rhythm, and Roll block includes hip-hop and reggae, while current specialty shows cover reggae, dub, electronic, ambient, international, world and Afro-beat music.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, dub, reggae and world-fusion releases have plausible fit, subject to human track-to-program matching.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: WREK explicitly authorizes email and physical music submissions and publishes a verified Music Director mailbox, but the current digital payload method is unspecified, the guidance sits on a legacy official subdomain and official postal-address representations conflict. Human review is required for route confirmation, payload format, international eligibility, rights, catalogue fit, metadata, content rules and AI-origin policy.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search and the complete open-pull-request patch were checked for WREK, wrek.org, the official submission path and music.director@wrek.org. No prior music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The Music Director email and physical-mail alternative are stored once as one canonical opportunity. Individual DJs, specialty shows, general contact, song requests, underwriting, advertising, PSA and duplicate simultaneous email/post routes are excluded.

notes: One new free-first WREK opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The public Music Director mailbox was source-verified, but no email or asset was sent. No form, login, CAPTCHA or payment workflow was used.
